svg.title: Recon Android Capture Design System
svg.desc: Static SVG component sheet for Recon's Android capture surface. Coordinates use dp-like units. Tap targets are at least 48dp; narrow divider lanes are gestures, not tap targets. Gesture starts are owned by their initial zone: gap for split, thumbnail for deletion/reorder. Material Icons paths are from google/material-design-icons, Apache-2.0.

symbol.text: Swipe the preview to switch modes

svg.text: Static SVG prototype · 1 unit ≈ 1dp · Android only · capture-first · Google Material Icons / Filled
Colored edge zones replace the active handle; their fade points toward travel.
24dp split gap between centered item groups
Divider centers in the gap; stable edge gutters stay clear.
Thumbnail alpha .75 · 18dp bottom glow · peak alpha .35
Dashed outline = initial slot; release below 40dp cancels.
Upright text, horizon, asymmetric object, and grid make orientation/crop/distortion errors visible.
Preview rule: preserve the selected capture aspect ratio. FIT_CENTER shows the full frame; FILL_CENTER is reserved for intentional crop.
Layout rule: window bounds decide placement; camera sensor metadata plus display rotation decide image direction.
Fold policy: rotation continues in the same recording; fold/unfold finalizes once before the next configuration.
The arrows describe input zones and the resulting state. Prototype annotations are not new in-app badges.

g.text: Idle only · changes VIDEO / PHOTO / VOICE
Pill tap is the direct-access fallback.
Right edge → left: discard amber + undo.
One item only · red delete glow.
Cancel before threshold; release to delete.
Drag left or right; slot snaps on release.
Gap starts split; thumbnail starts delete.

svg.text: While recording: mode, queue, lens, flash, and mic controls lock. Stop remains available.
Rotation updates the active recording in place. Fold/unfold stops and finalizes once, then rebinds the next configuration.
State assemblies, not window-layout artboards. Selected mode stays visible; Stop stays enabled while queue actions lock.
Mic / lens locked · Stop active · queued media retained
Camera controls hidden · Stop active · queued media retained
